verdicts.reason: A keeps the bottle-on-cream-circle motif, but the headline floats top-centre on no shared edge with the bottle or buttons. NEW and Try It sit in a loose mid-row with a big dead band above them, and the faint decorative circle is clipped at the top-left corner. B breaks the key motif: the cream circle is left orphaned and clipped in the bottom-left corner while an oversized bottle stands alone mid-canvas. The headline runs almost into the bottle, and the NEW/Try It column on the right is disconnected from the headline, which leaves the layout scattered.
